{{Quote|General Tiin, the ship is lost."<br />"Then it's time we get a new one.|The ''Impavid''{{'s}} clone commander and Saesee Tiin|<ref name="CW23" />}}
The '''''Impavid''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] serving in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy's]] [[Coruscant Defense Fleet/Legends|Coruscant Home Fleet]]&mdash;which was tasked with defending the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]&mdash;during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|invaded]] the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]], the ''Impavid'' was [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the capitol planet when it was hit by a Separatist [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] exiting [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Seeing the collision, [[High Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] flew aboard the ''Impavid'' in his [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|personal starfighter]] where he was informed by the ''Impavid''{{'s}} [[Unidentified clone trooper commander (Impavid)|clone commander]] that the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] was too heavily damaged to continue fighting. Taking command of the ''Impavid'', [[General/Legends|General]] Tiin ordered the [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]] to pass over the Separatist [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier]] ''[[Prosperous/Legends|Prosperous]]''. With the ''Impavid'' directly over the ''Prosperous'', Tiin and several of the ''Impavid''{{'s}} [[clone marine]]s boarded the enemy vessel and seized the ''Prosperous''.

==Description==
[[File:ImpavidCrash-CW23.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Impavid'' is hit by the Separatist cruiser coming out of hyperspace.]]
The ''Impavid'' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="db">{{DB|character|saeseetiin|Tiin, Saesee}}</ref>&mdash;manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]<ref name="Venator" />&mdash;in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|war]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The ''Impavid'' had six [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and two [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command towers]] installed, as well as several [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]]. The Star Destroyer had at least two [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bays, having one large dorsal flight deck on its bow&mdash;which had several [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighters]] stationed aboard&mdash;and a smaller hangar on the ship's port side.<ref name="CW23" />

==History==
{{Quote|Prepare to board!|General Tiin before abandoning the ''Impavid''|<ref name="CW23" />}}
During the Clone Wars, the ''Impavid''<ref name="db" /> served in [[Coruscant Defense Fleet/Legends|Coruscant Home Fleet]], which was the defense [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] for the Republic's capital [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="III">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], towards the very end of the war, the Confederacy launched a full-scale [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|attack]] on the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]], catching the Republic unprepared. The ''Impavid'' itself was in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over Coruscant when the battle started, with dozens of Separatist [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] and [[Warship/Legends|warships]] exiting [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] around the Star Destroyer. However, there were too many Separatists ships around the ''Impavid'' for the [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]] to avoid, and the ''Impavid'' was hit on its port side by a Confederate [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] leaving hyperspace. The collision heavily damaged the Republic vessel, with its bow trailing a large amount of fire and the ship's hull beginning to tear apart.<ref name="CW23" />

The collision between the two ships was witnessed by [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], who was flying in his personal [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Jedi starfighter]], having taken command of the Republic's space defense. [[General/Legends|General]] Tiin landed in the doomed ''Impavid''{{'s}} main hangar, where the ship's [[Unidentified clone trooper commander (Impavid)|clone commander]] informed the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] that the Star Destroyer was lost and needed to be abandoned. Tiin decided to take command of the ''Impavid'', coming up with a plan to escape the failing vessel.<ref name="CW23" />

[[File:Saesee_and_Clones_Attack.jpg|thumb|250px|Clone marines and General Tiin jump out of the ''Impavid''.]]
The Jedi General ordered the ''Impavid'' to pass over a nearby Separatist cruiser, the ''Providence''-class carrier ''[[Prosperous/Legends|Prosperous]]'', with the ''Impavid'' firing its turbolasers at the Separatist cruiser. After donning pressurized [[Environment suit/Legends|space suits]], Tiin and hundreds of the ''Impavid''{{'s}} [[clone marine]]s jumped out of ''Impavid''{{'s}} port-side hangar, towards the ''Prosperous''. Flying through debris-filled [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]], Tiin and the clone marines landed on the ''Prosperous''{{'s}} hull, and&mdash;fighting their way into the Confederate capital ship&mdash;managed to capture the ''Prosperous''<ref name="CW23" /> and return to Coruscant.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Commander and crew==
At the time of the Battle of Coruscant, the ''Impavid'' was crewed by hundreds of elite clone marines, led by a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]]. After the ''Impavid'' was damaged during the battle, Saesee Tiin took command for a short time, ordering the ''Impavid''{{'s}} [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to abandon the failing destroyer and to seize the ''Prosperous''.<ref name="CW23" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Impavid'' first appeared as an unnamed Star Destroyer in [[Chapter 23 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|Chapter 23]] of the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars|''Star Wars: Clone Wars'' animated series]], which first aired [[March 23]], [[2005]]. The ''Impavid''{{'s}} name was later revealed in Saesee Tiin's [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry on [[StarWars.com]], and the ship was given an entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', published [[December 9]], [[2008]].

In the ''Clone Wars'' episode, when the ''Impavid'' is shown being hit by the Separatist cruiser coming out of hyperspace, it appears to be ripped in half by the collision. However, in the very next scene, the ''Impavid'' is shown&mdash;although heavily damaged&mdash;in one piece. For the rest of the episode, the ''Impavid'' is drawn as one full ship; thus, this article assumes that the ''Impavid'' remained intact during the events of the episode.
